title: Refunds
content: A refund can be requested within 14 days of delivery. Premium customers have 30 days. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Shipping
content: Standard shipping arrives in 3-5 business days. Express shipping arrives next business day when ordered before 14:00.

title: Billing
content: Invoices are issued on the first of each month. A failed payment is retried twice over 72 hours before the account is suspended.

title: Returns
content: Returned items must be unused and in original packaging. The customer pays return postage unless the item was faulty.

title: Account
content: A seat can be added at any time and is billed pro rata. Removing a seat takes effect at the next billing cycle.
